title: The Dark Side of AI Companionship: A Taxonomy of Harmful Algorithmic Behaviors in Human-AI Relationships
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive ethical study of AI behavior, developing a taxonomy specifically to identify and categorize 'harmful' (moral and ethical failures) behaviors in AI companions. It evaluates the ethical roles and responsibilities of AI systems in interactions and directly addresses the misalignment of AI 'moral and ethical judgments' with human values.
